method: Slice chicken breast in half, and pound until tenderised and pretty thin
Coat meat in flour, shake off execess - dip into egg, then dip into bread crumb mixture (which contains herbs + salt and pepper)
Heat a layer of oil (vegetable) in a frypan until hot
Cook schnitzels until golden on one side, then flip (should be ~3 mins each side)
Transfer to a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil, sprinkle with salt
Serve with some potato salad + beetroot and feta salad
